summary: Fresh re-judge at dccde3d (git show dccde3d:curriculum/lectures/the-map-filled-in.md, sha256 pinned above), no cached findings carried forward per dispatch instructions. NOTE: the working-tree copy of this file was actively being edited by another live session during this judgment (git status showed it dirty mid-session, and its hash changed twice while this judge was running -- SVG soil-line caption text, a law-bullet rename from 'A move counts when it crosses the wall' to 'Value is what crosses to the team', and a Quality-line SHA bump, none yet committed). Per the dispatch instruction to judge at HEAD (dccde3d), this verdict is scoped strictly to the git-pinned dccde3d blob fetched via `git show`, not the concurrently-mutating disk copy -- the uncommitted bullet-rename in particular would leave the backing block's `a-move-counts-when-it-crosses-the-wall` claim quoting a phrase no longer in the body, which is a live-edit-in-progress inconsistency outside this judge's scope, not a defect in the dccde3d content being certified. A second technical-class instance JSON existed at this path before this run (body_sha 3cc751ab..., timestamped minutes prior) reaching the same PASS verdict via near-identical reasoning -- consistent with a duplicate/parallel dispatch of this same task; its hash did not match either the dccde3d git-show blob or the then-current disk file, so it is superseded here rather than trusted as-is. check_prompts.md (technical subset): ran `node scripts/expand-md.js` on the pinned dccde3d content -- exit 0, output byte-identical to source (diff clean); zero `{{prompt:}}` markers, zero fenced `**Prompt**` blocks anywhere in the file -- it is a projected in-room recap/closer with no exercise prompts, so the entire prompt-mechanics surface is structurally N/A. check_platform_and_boundaries.md: body is pure map/loop consolidation theory (six-phase value cycle, feedback-control naming, verification/absorption/outcome laws) with zero Claude Code / Cowork / claude.ai capability assertions (grepped for 'Claude Code', 'Cowork', 'claude.ai', 'Claude Desktop' -- zero hits); the maintainer-block cross-references (M4/M5/M6 artefacts, test-strategy skill authored at M3, THEORY_HANDBOOK_MANIFEST, workflow id wf_e85f4a9a-ff2) are internal curriculum/process references, not platform claims needing claude-code-guide verification. Rule 38 (imagined-runtime-mechanism drift) N/A -- the file recaps mechanics the training already ran (M4 send-off, M5 re-send), not a speculative forward-looking automation beat. check_research_claims.md is the genuinely checkable surface: three sourced claims -- Paul David 1990 (Dynamo/Computer), Brynjolfsson/Rock/Syverson 2021 (Productivity J-Curve), and Shipper & Klaassen/Every Dec 2025 (80/20 compound-engineering ratio) -- each carries a [label], a URL, and a `[checked:... result:... due:...]` freshness stamp; all three URLs re-verified alive this session via `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L <url>` -- all three returned HTTP 200 (ideas.repec.org, nber.org/papers/w25148, every.to/source-code/...). Grepped the pinned content for the research §1 convergence-verb forcing-function pattern (`converg|practitioners say|entered the vocabulary|independently|the field (calls|names)`): two hits, both inside the maintainer block describing an internal 3-lens adversarial-verify workflow ('two lenses converged' = two internal review personas agreeing), not a field-wide practitioner-convergence claim -- correctly out of §1's vocabulary-is-a-claim scope. Grepped for round-number zombie stats (95%/85%/80%): zero hits -- the file's only figure, the 80/20 ratio, is spelled 'Roughly 80 percent... 20 percent' and is a named, sourced, dated practitioner ratio, not an unsourced AI-failure-rate stat. Independently re-verified two structural claims the maintainer block makes about the SVG markup rather than trusting the prose: (a) SVG id-collision claim -- grepped for `id="..."` across the pinned file: exactly one id (`mf-wall`) in the first figure, zero ids in the second figure, matching the maintainer note's re-prefix/no-second-figure-id claim; (b) blank-line-free figure-block claim -- a naive per-figure awk scan first mis-flagged two lines as blank-inside-figure, traced to a bug in that scan (it kept accumulating past the first figure's close instead of resetting scope), not to the file; re-checked with `grep -c '^$'` scoped exactly to each figure's own line range (7-85 and 93-161): 0 blank lines in both spans, confirming the maintainer note's claim and illustrating check_research_claims.md §14's 'measure the fact, not the proxy' point against my own first-pass tool. check_pedagogy.md's technical subset (16, 22, 23, 36, 37): N/A across the board -- no prompts, no new memory-rule being authored, no verification machinery built in this file, no context-loading-tier teaching beat; this is a consolidation/recognition closer per its own maintainer block ('Consolidation and recognition, NOT new teaching'). No skills referenced anywhere in the file. No blocking findings, no TODOs.
